The store tree was enumerated too, which the earlier sweeps had not done: `store.ui.com/us/en/pro/products/` (234 archived URLs) and `store.ui.com/us/en/products/` filtered to `udw` hold only `udw`, `udw?variant=udw-us` (captured 2026-04-28, so the crawl is live) and the accessory `uacc-psu-udw`, with no `udw-pro` in any spelling or year. Caveat recorded: a radio-identical variant could in principle ship under a Class II permissive change, so this rules out a filed authorization, not the existence of the product; and a grant publishes frequencies, never port counts. research/ubiquiti-swx-grantee-census.md.  Then, 2026-11-19, the surface no earlier pass had read: Ubiquiti's own firmware index, `https://fw-update.ubnt.com/api/firmware?limit=1000&filter=eq~~product~~unifi-dream` -> HTTP 200, **340 releases across 17 platform codes** (`UDM`, `UDMPRO`, `UDMPROSE`, `UDMPROMAX`, `UDR`, `UDR5G`, `UDR7`, `UDRULT`, `UDW`, `UX`, `UXMAX`, `UCGF`, `UCGMAX`, `UCGA6AD`, `EFGCORE`, `UDMENT`, `UDMEA4C`), with `UDW` at 27 releases from 2022-05-07 to 2026-11-10 (latest `v6.0.17+7bcad58`, binary `/data/unifi-dream/2d04-UDW-6.0.17-…bin`) and **no `UDWPRO`**: the spellings `UDWPRO`, `UDW-PRO`, `UDWPROMAX`, `UDW2`, `UDWSE`, `UDWMAX` each return the 96-byte 0-release envelope, the same answer as the nonsense control `ZZZZ`, while `UDMPRO` returns 65, `UDMPROSE` 40 and `UDMPROMAX` 20 - three near-identical consoles that nevertheless carry three separate platform codes, which is why a shipped Pro Dream Wall would have its own. Caveat: a rebadged variant sharing the parent mainboard could hide under the `UDW` code, and no firmware index publishes port counts. research/ubiquiti-firmware-platform-census.md. The 86 include six 硬件描述 editions (R022C10 EDOC1100303423, R023C00 EDOC1100328735, R023C10 EDOC1100367203, R024C10 EDOC1100456168, R025C00 EDOC1100525984, R025C10 EDOC1100558549), the R026C00 产品文档 bundle EDOC1100625827, the E6616X快速安装指南 EDOC1100299473, the three E6616X release documents EDOC1100376749/50/51, and the English HD EDOC1100456166 the census had counted as absent.
